theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intros Hup Hinit
  have Hl := UpdateStatesLength Hup
  have Hl' := InitStatesLength Hinit
  have Hnd : ks.Disjoint ks' := by
    intro x hx hx'
    have hd := UpdateStatesDefined Hup x hx
    rw [InitStatesNotDefined Hinit x hx'] at hd
    exact absurd hd (by simp)
  refine ⟨updatedStates σ ks' vs', rfl, ?_, ?_⟩
  · exact updatedStatesInit Hl'
      (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined Hinit) Hup) (InitStatesNodup Hinit)
  · rw [InitStatesUpdated Hinit, UpdateStatesUpdated Hup]
    have Hc : updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks vs) ks' vs'
        = updatedStates (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ks vs := by
      simp only [updatedStates]
      refine updatedStatesComm ?_
      rw [List.unzip_zip_left (l₁ := ks) (l₂ := vs) (Nat.le_of_eq Hl),
          List.unzip_zip_left (l₁ := ks') (l₂ := vs') (Nat.le_of_eq Hl')]
      exact Hnd
    rw [Hc]
    exact updatedStatesUpdate Hl (updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' Hup))
